notes.title: Sign up for Berghotel Heist Public Beta Weekend
notes.notes:
[p]Berghotel Heist [b]public beta[/b] test will take place on 6th and 7th of September 2025. 
The game is best enjoyed in co-op mode, so we encourage you to sign up together with a friend, or request multiple keys (up to four) using the form below:[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/1zy4M1rGQHP9XW9BA"]https://forms.gle/1zy4M1rGQHP9XW9BA[/url][/p][p][/p][p]It is an invite-only event, and you will receive the keys few days before the beta test starts, so make sure to register timely.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We are looking forward to your feedback![/b]
[/p][p align="start"]In the meantime, make sure to join official [b]Berghotel Heist[/b] Discord server to:[/p][list][*][p]📰 Get the [b]development updates[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]🎭 [b]Live events [/b]announcements[/p][/*][*][p]🧪 Grab [b]invites to playtests[/b] and help us shape the game[/p][/*][*][p]💬 Send [b]feedback, bug reports, and feature ideas[/b] directly to the team[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🔗 [b]Join here:[/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/CyVqp5u82H"]https://discord.com/invite/CyVqp5u82H[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p]

notes.title: Berghotel Heist @ AniNite '25
notes.notes:
[p]After our debut at the Level Up last month, we are happy to announce that Berghotel Heist will be presented at [b]AniNite '25[/b] in Vienna! 
[/p][p]☝️ If you are there, stop by and play the latest demo! 🎮 [/p][p]✌️ If you have friends who are there, tell them to stop by and play the latest demo!! 🎮
